title: Onboarding: Journey Breadcrumbs & Fallback Cards — illustration set and troubleshooting sprites
creator: Lina Park
description: Create a cohesive set of onboarding visuals that live inside the Quickstart flow: compact "breadcrumb" UI that shows progress and fallback cards that surface next-best actions when errors occur (rate limit, timeout, transient retries). Deliverables include static SVGs, animated micro-sprites (GIF + Lottie-ready), and screenshot overlays for the Console guide. Focus on discoverability, compressing the troubleshooting path, and compatibility with Redwood Console theme variants.
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumb component designs (3 states) with copy variants and accessibility contrast pass (WCAG AA)
Fallback card art for rate-limit, timeout, and retry exhausted with 3 severity patterns (info/warning/error)
Exports: SVG icon set (mono + colored), 48/24 px raster fallbacks, animated sprite sheet (2x density) and GIF preview
Figma file with named layers and tokens, plus DRY component variants for Console's light/dark themes
Developer handoff doc with example Console markup, suggested aria attributes, and token names

decisions: Use inline breadcrumb + compact fallback card pattern rather than full-screen modal for onboarding errors to keep context.
Color coding: info (blue), warning (yellow), error (red) — use tokenized colors from console-theme v3.
Animation format: primary export Lottie JSON + GIF fallback for docs. Sprite sheet provided to reduce runtime asset requests.
Copy approach: prioritized action-first CTAs; include secondary 'Learn more' link to docs for advanced troubleshooting.
